templates.name: live_stream_completion
templates.description: Keep visible chat replies complete and trace any cutoff.
templates.objective: Stream natural replies until the model is done, then record whether the reply ended normally or hit a budget/timeout.
sop: Use one stream owner for the visible reply.
After tools finish, send a visible final reply chunk.
If response budget ends generation, mark the trace as clipped.
templates.tool_context_rule: Tool calls run in a separate tool context and return compact evidence only.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric defines stream behavior; runtime traces store timings and finish reasons.

templates.name: post_reply_indexing_fast_path
templates.description: Prevent background indexing from looking like the model is still replying.
templates.objective: After a reply, write lexical/DB evidence first and defer semantic model embeddings unless explicitly enabled.
sop: Store prompt/reply evidence cheaply.
Do not wake Ollama for semantic embeddings on ordinary chat turns.
Batch heavy indexing into an explicit research/build lane.
templates.tool_context_rule: Post-reply indexing is not a user-visible tool call.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores policy; vector DB stores lexical and optional semantic points.

templates.name: aider_coding_lane
templates.description: Aider is the coding terminal lane and evidence recorder.
templates.objective: Use Aider for code edits when a task requires terminal-visible pair-programming evidence.
sop: Start Aider only for approved coding work.
Record stdout, stderr, diffs, and tests to the Web UI.
Let the model talk naturally before and after terminal evidence.
templates.tool_context_rule: Aider output appears in the terminal evidence panel, not as raw chat context.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores when/how to use Aider; terminal logs store what Aider did.

templates.name: lava_event_ui_recorder
templates.description: LAVA records KQML/SOAP/GC events for the Web UI.
templates.objective: Use the LAVA event plane as volatile coordination and UI evidence, not as long-term wisdom.
sop: Record each agent/tool phase as an event.
Expose recent events to the UI.
Distill only successful patterns back to DB/Fabric after evidence.
templates.tool_context_rule: LAVA event payloads are summarized before entering the main reply.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores LAVA purpose; LAVA DB stores volatile events.

templates.name: soap_success_implementation
templates.description: SOAP optimizer lane for heuristic candidate scoring.
templates.objective: Use SOAP-style adaptive scoring for genetic coder candidates while keeping training conservative and evidence-based.
sop: Mutate candidates.
Score with tests and static signals.
Update heuristic weights conservatively.
Promote only passing samples.
templates.tool_context_rule: SOAP scores are tool evidence, not raw conversational content.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores the SOAP SOP; DB stores samples, scores, and pass/fail traces.

templates.name: research_success_implementation
templates.description: Research lane for source-grounded implementation work.
templates.objective: Collect source evidence, compress it into implementation-relevant rules, and cite the source of each rule.
sop: Prefer official docs and primary repositories.
Extract rules, APIs, constraints, and examples.
Store citations in DB/vector, not Fabric prose.
templates.tool_context_rule: Research tools return compressed evidence and links.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores research workflow; DB/vector store citations and extracted facts.

templates.name: system_variable_performance_trace
templates.description: Correlate runtime variables with observed AI performance.
templates.objective: Measure response latency, timeout, model, context, vector mode, Fabric count, and postprocess behavior before changing variables.
sop: Record current variables.
Run a small prompt set.
Compare before/after with one changed variable.
Keep the variable only if evidence improves.
templates.tool_context_rule: Diagnostics run outside the main chat context and report a compact table.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores method; runtime traces and benchmarks store observations.

templates.name: fifty_optimization_phases
templates.objective: Apply optimization in phases: stream, model, context, retrieval, postprocess, tools, UI, evidence, rollback, and docs.
sop: List candidate optimizations.
Group into phases.
Apply one runtime-affecting variable at a time.
Verify with compile, health, and Web UI/API smoke tests.
templates.tool_context_rule: Optimization evidence is summarized, not dumped.
templates.data_boundary: Fabric stores optimization SOP; DB/logs store measurements.
